note: Side camera floor model made by the robots (2026-10-26, tools/experiment/analyses_oct26/twocam/pooled.py): pixel = C + (q - C)(1 + kappa |q - C|^2), q = H [x, y, 1] (overhead track.csv floor cm, roam1 frame, robot-top plane) -> side pixel of the robot's outline centre; C = (320, 240). Fitted on 6,650 pairs from sessions 2026-10-25 15:10, 15:45, 21:14 and 2026-10-26 09:55, each at its own lag. It inherits the overhead's systematic offset (about 4.7 cm against side_floorcal_roam1.json).
